شللتم (form I)
# شَلِلْتُمْ (šaliltum) /ʃa.lil.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of شَلَّ (šalla)
# شَلَلْتُمْ (šalaltum) /ʃa.lal.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of شَلَّ (šalla)
# شُلِلْتُمْ (šuliltum) /ʃu.lil.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of شَلَّ (šalla) and شُلَّ (šulla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
